description:
Read, write, delete, lease, or list shared behavior tree blackboard state variables (actions: get, set, delete, lease, list). Use manage_blackboard instead of set_parameters when coordinating state across behavior nodes or acquiring agent mutex leases.

Returns blackboard value, lease acquisition status, or key listings.

action.description: Blackboard operation: get, set, delete, lease, list

mode.description: Lease action mode: acquire or release (default: acquire)

name: manage_blackboard
